components.name: Category Pill
components.css: .ds-cat-pill { padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); color: #94A3B8; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-cat-pill.active { background: #FF4D00; color: #FFFFFF; border-color: #FF4D00; }

components.name: Order Action Button
components.description: Interactive action button to open detail modal or WhatsApp
components.css: .ds-btn-order { background: #22C55E; color: #FFFFFF; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 18px; border: none; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: transform 0.15s, opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-order:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

narrative.overview: NEGOVA Digital Menus are built as fast, immersive, touch-optimized web applications designed for immediate diner discovery and high-conversion ordering. They are not static PDF boards, printable brochures, or skeuomorphic parchment cards.
keyCharacteristics: Web-First Ergonomics with horizontal scroll pills and bottom-sheet customization
Authentic Identity Over Gimmicks (no caution tape, no fake stickers)
Single Elevation Hierarchy (clean borders, no fuzzy halos)

rules.name: The Single-Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent color is used on ≤10% of the screen.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings stand on their own without fake kicker badges.

rules.name: The Single-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Declare border OR shadow, never stacked fuzzy halos.

dos: Format all prices with business currency and proper number grouping.
Show real variants with 'Desde $X' and variant count pills.
Open ProductDetailModal for customizations before ordering.
donts: Don't use native alerts (window.alert, window.confirm, window.prompt).
Don't invent fake products or placeholder categories.
Don't replicate physical printed paper menu skeuomorphism.
